theorem_title: Exact twelve-step recurrence of the mechanical envelope
natural_language_statement:
For $s\in\mathbb N$, define $M(0)=0$, $M(s+1)=3M(s)+2^{\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor}$, and $e(s)=\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor+1$. For $B,x\in\mathbb N$, define the normalized twelve-term numerator $N_{12}(B,x)=\sum_{i=0}^{11}3^{11-i}D_i(B,x)$. Here $f_i=\lfloor\log_2(3^i)\rfloor$, and $D_i(B,x)$ is $2^{f_i}B$ when $3^i x<2^{f_i+1}B$, and $2^{f_i+1}B$ otherwise.

For every $s\in\mathbb N$,

$$
M(s+12)=3^{12}M(s)+N_{12}\bigl(2^{\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor},3^s\bigr).
$$

This groups twelve scalar recurrence steps while preserving all dyadic rounding phases.
